summary: Iteration 45 — validated the new batch (2 golden expert push, 3 API budget reserve, 4 AI-tip correction, 5 ISO-with-TZ kickoff fix). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Correction endpoint requires auth (401 without token), rejects non-AI tips with 422 'Only AI tips can be corrected', preserves stake and sets corrected flags on AI tips. Regression: /api/tips works, HoF is empty pre-Aug-1, no Russian keywords. Frontend: KI Single-Game-Picks area renders the blue 'Korrigieren' button (data-testid correct-tip-*) + hidden file input on every AI card (20 buttons + 20 inputs, all mapped to AI sources); Community area has zero correct-tip buttons. ISO-with-TZ kickoff bug is fixed — 2 verified tips (17:00+01:00 shown as 18:00 CEST, 20:15+01:00 shown as 21:15 CEST). One card is visibly 'KORRIGIERT' with 'Manuell korrigiert auf: Double Chance 1X (Gesamtquote 2.10). Einsatz unverändert.' — end-to-end correction actually landed in prod. Expert push branch + digest use /push-expert.png icon+badge, sound 'expert', tag 'tipjar-expert', 🔮 title (verified in code). /app/frontend/public/push-expert.png present. API reserve: _api_note_headers records rate-limit headers, _api_reserve_locked returns False when unknown / evening (UTC>=15), True daytime <=50% remaining; live_loop and member_live_loop both call it before polling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 9130 lines — beyond the 700-line guideline. Should be split (auth, tips, admin, live, insights modules). Not blocking but overdue.
correct_tip endpoint returns full tip via find_one with {_id:0} projection — good, no ObjectId leak.
_api_reserve_locked correctly reserves 50% budget before 15:00 UTC and lets evening run freely; verified live_loop + member_live_loop both honour it (2 call sites).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For future iterations: pytest needs `-o addopts=''` to override the -n xdist default in /app/backend/pytest.ini when running a single file. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported before pytest. AI area is opened via header pill text 'KI Single-Ga' (German UI when tj_lang='de'). The button label for correction is 'Korrigieren'. ISO-with-TZ kickoff conversion works via i18n.js kickoffInfo → _tzParts(KICKOFF_BASE_TZ, realMs).
